No front door

Followers stay followers

Someone can save your reels for a year and never join an email list. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Every enquiry starts from zero

Coaching, therapy and evaluations all sit behind one link. A class lets people see how you think first, so the ones who apply for coaching already trust your approach.

Content treadmill

2,809 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post. When you step back to rest or see clients, the enquiries step back too.

The people who feel seen by your content but aren't ready for 1:1 today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills your 1:1 coaching

Fixes the missing front door

One class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every buyer is an email you own, and every one of them has already said yes to you once.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites people who want hands-on support to apply for coaching. You only talk to people who paid, watched, and told you what they want help with.

Pays for the ads

The $17 seat and the toolkit bring revenue in on day one, so the ads are largely funded by the front end while coaching clients are the profit.

The 95%*

Not ready for 1:1 yet

They buy a $17 seat, grab the toolkit, and keep learning from your emails and content. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for hands-on support

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for coaching.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The advice that backfires"

Hook
"A lot of the productivity advice out there was never designed for neurodivergent brains. Here's why that matters." (to camera, same setting and red lip as your profile)
Body
"Most systems assume motivation shows up on schedule and energy is the same every day. For a lot of ADHD and autistic adults, it isn't. So when the system doesn't fit the brain, people blame themselves, and nobody is doing anything wrong." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach what to build instead in a live 90-minute class called The Unmasked Week. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you plan a week"

Hook
"Before anyone plans their week, I want them to ask these three questions." (Amy holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: what drained me most last week? Two: where is my real recovery time? Three: which routine can bend on a hard day instead of breaking? The answers change the whole plan." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go through the full approach in my live masterclass, The Unmasked Week. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me where to start: my resources, my content, or coaching. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, don't pick yet. Come to my live class first. You'll learn how I think about building a life that works with your brain, try a few tools that week, and know which next step fits."
CTA
"It's called The Unmasked Week, it's $17, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
